name: fleet-audit-path-in-consumer-records
title: Correct the fleet install-audit path cited in consumer task records
description: Five consumers refreshed in campaign `v0-71-33-20260819T095717Z` carry a task PRD acceptance criterion citing `scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-install-audit.py` as if it were a path inside the consumer, and four of the five repeat it in the journal testing note for the same session. Every one of those consumers is a thin install, so no such file exists there. Correct those nine records, correct rwbp-website's unreachable work-commit citation, and close the source of the mistake in this pack's own documentation.
